about_the_game:
Welcome to a unique psychiatric treatment facility.

In "Cyber Paranoia," you've been hospitalized for a mental contagion and selected as a test subject for experimental therapy. Your doctor introduces you to what appears to be a perfect young man - but he's actually a humanoid android.

You'll participate in various "treatment sessions" with this android, ranging from tender care to intense punitive experiences, as you navigate the thin, dangerous line between love, submission, pain, and control.

Every decision you make will shape the android's responses and destiny - and ultimately determine your own fate.

Target Audience

  • Fans of dark otome and female-targeted content

  • Players interested in power dynamics and psychological themes

  • Those who enjoy yandere characters, android romance, and sci-fi psychological thrillers

Features

  • Rich Interactions: Choose from dozens of treatment options spanning gentle care, disciplinary sessions, sensory experiences, romantic encounters, and mechanical procedures

  • Complete Control: Manage your daily routine - schedule treatments, take breaks, submit progress reports, or engage in secret after-hours interactions

  • Dynamic Character Evolution: Watch the android's personality transform based on your choices, evolving from defiance to compliance to obsessive dependency

  • Multiple Story Paths: Your treatment methods and approach unlock entirely different storylines and endings

  • Stunning Visuals: Beautiful android character artwork with unlockable special costumes and appearances

  • Mature Content Warning: Certain routes feature graphic content including violence, psychological abuse, medical procedures, and adult themes.

content_descriptors.notes:
This game contains sexual themes and nudity, but does not depict explicit sexual acts.
Some story routes involve forced violence and gore, including imagery and descriptions of dissection.
The game also contains mild BDSM elements (in a non-sexual context).
